messages.ko: 오늘은 주빈이 생일. 모두 축하 해주셨나요?
messages.en: Today is Joobin's birthday. Did everyone congratulate her?
Since Joobin was born...
How many years has it been...
It's been 17 years now.

messages.ko: 주빈이는 현제 일반고가 아니라 고등학교 입학 개념은 아니지만
messages.en: Joobin isn't attending a regular high school right now, so it's not really the usual 'starting high school' situation.
But age-wise, she's become a proper high school student.
Can you believe it? Our little baby Joobin is already a high school student.
I really can't believe it.
Joobin is someone who usually...
always gives her all to fulfill the responsibilities she's given.
She's grown so much because of that.
From my perspective, as someone who's watched her up close...

messages.ko: 남들이 성숙하고 어른스러운 아이이다 다큰것같다 라는 이야기를 하지만
messages.en: people say she's mature, grown-up, and seems like an adult already.

messages.ko: 사실은 마음이 아주여리고 여느 또래와같이 지나가는 낙엽에 웃기도하고 울기도하는 그런 아이입니다
messages.en: But in reality, she has a very soft heart, and just like anyone her age, she's the kind of person who can laugh or cry over something as simple as a falling leaf.
*sniff sniff*
Sometimes I wonder if she thinks I'm the younger one.
She acts like she's the unnie all the time.
Even so, she's such an adorable little sister.
Anyway, once again, happy birthday to Joobin!
Wait a second!
I brought the gift Joobin said she wanted!
It's a Choonsik bowl.
I remember putting this on my own birthday wishlist too.
I even remember hoping and praying that I'd receive it!!
Haha... that's a little embarrassing.
